nodes.long_description:
Crystal Conquest is a **Free-To-Play** VR game where you **control the elements** and battle for victory. Harness the power of fire, water, earth, and air in epic 3v3 MOBA-inspired combat or intense dueling modes! Team up with your friends against AI or choose to fight in PvP!

**Build your mage:** Choose the class that matches your playstyle and elements. Unlock class variants as you grow and customize your build. 

**Harness the elements:** Battle with elemental magic where each element has unique properties. Use earth, fire, water, and wind to block, dodge, and deflect your enemy's attacks. 

**Grow in Power:** Level up and unlock even more epic spells that change how you control the elements.

**Choose Your Battle Mode:** Battle in 3v3 matches to capture crystals and topple towers, face off in duels, or team up in co-op to take on waves of AI. All modes support AI for solo or practice play.

nodes.change_log:
Patch 1.1.0 Notes 

New Features
- Added in game announcements!
- You can now cast most spells while holding a weapon! Some spells require slamming your hammer on the ground or shooting an arrow
- Major bot improvements (dodging, blocking, dashing/teleporting, healing, fleeing, guardian movement, etc...)
- Boulders can now be launched with any Geomancer weapon!

Balancing Changes:
- Crystal lockout timers no longer increase past 30 seconds
- Adjusted bot difficulty in Conquest and lowered it for multiplayer matches
- Lowered Geomancer damage by ~10%
- Reduced ring upgrade costs
- Reduced Vacuum Burst's silence duration to 3 seconds
- Removed two hand mana cost penalty when a spell or weapon in one hand is fully charged
- Reduced levels of some of the bots in the last two levels of Gauntlet
- Reduced the amount of homing for most projectiles
- Reduced the damage of super golems

Bug Fixes and Improvements:
- Fixed various issues with bot hand positioning and twisting
- Removed spell cast delays on various spells like the Boulder in multiplayer matches
- Fixed a bow issues where the string could get stuck or the secondary arrow mode would always activate
- Improved weapon throwing accuracy
- Improved spell hit and block accuracy at high latency
- Prevented players from damaging guardians when outside their attack range
- Fixed a crash that could happen while using weapons in multiplayer matches
- Fixed issues with golem aiming and golems getting stuck
- Fixed an issue which caused the barrier spell to shift position rapidly
- Some spell effects no longer make long streaks when spawning in multiplayer matches
- Spell menu changes: Spell menu spells are no longer restricted to one hand
- Many minor fixes

Hotfix 1:
- Fixed issue which could prevent players from joining a multiplayer match when playing a single player mode

Minor Update 1:
- Added Kickstarter announcement poster!
